description: We need a hands-on engineer to build, improve and own the company's AI systems: turn business needs into working solutions, connect tools and workflows, fix bugs and keep the system reliable. Build AI tools, automations, integrations and internal applications; integrate AI with existing software, APIs, databases and workflows; monitoring, secure access and documentation; reduce manual work. Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, LLM APIs, AI agents, databases, cloud deployment, n8n or Make. How to apply: share your CV and examples of systems, integrations or automations you have personally built, the problem each addressed, your contribution and the results. AED 10,000+ per month. Work location: remote.
score_reason: قوية في التوافق مع مهاراتك والجدية (أتمتة، وكلاء ذكاء اصطناعي، بايثون، ويب)، وأضعف نقطة الميزانية؛ الشريحة: الخليج.
title: AI Systems and Automation Engineer
